title: Thread/Identity/Submission changes responses missing required updatedProperties field
description: RFC 8620 §5.2 requires 'updatedProperties' in ALL /changes responses. thread.rs, identity.rs, and submission.rs omit it. email.rs and mailbox.rs include it correctly. A client that reads updatedProperties from Thread/changes or Identity/changes will get undefined behavior (missing key). Fix: add 'updatedProperties': Value::Null to the json\! in handle_thread_changes, handle_identity_changes, handle_submission_changes.
